paite: Atatlekna ngaihdam a om a, akhelhna khuh a om in nuam asa hi.
heading: David La / Thuphatawina Leh Ngaihdamna
english: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

paite: TOUPA'N thulimlouhna nei a aseh louh a, akha a khemna himhim omloumi in nuam asa hi.
english: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

paite: Ka khelhna ka genkhiak louh lai in, nitum a ka mau nilouhna in ka guhte atak khin vekta hi.
english: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

paite: Sun leh zan in na khut in na hon delh a; ka tui nawnna leng, khal nisa in thil ahihlamdang bang in, alamdang hialta hi. Selah
english: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

paite: Ka khelhna na kiang ah ka puang a, ka thulimlouhna ka imta kei hi, ka tatlekna TOUPA kiang ah ka pulak ding a, ka chi a; huchi in ka khelh thulimlouhna na ngaidamta hi. Selah
english: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian limsak michih in zon muh baihlam a na om lai in na kiang ah thum chiat uhen; tui liante ahong let hun chiang in amau aphazou kei ding hi.
english: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

paite: Nang ka bukna mun na hi a, mangbatna lak ah na hon humbit ding a; humbitna late in na hon umsuaksak ding. Selah
english: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

paite: Na paina lampi ah ka hon hilh pil dia, ka hon chil ding; ka mit in ka hon pi ding a, ka hon suangtuahsak zel ding hi.
english: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

paite: Ngaihtuahna nei lou sakol hiam, sabiltung hiam bang in om ke'nla; tuate letkipna ding asikbah leh kaihkhawlna khau ahi a, huchi lou in na kiangnai ah ahong pai kei ding uhi.
english: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

paite: Migilou-salou a ding lungkhamna tampi a-om ding; TOUPA muangte bel zahngaihna in a-umsuak zaw ding hi.
english: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.

paite: Midiktatte aw, TOUPA ah nuam in kipak unla; lungtang diktak pu tengteng aw, nuam in kikou un.
english: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
